task.instruction: Search a hotel with free WiFi and air conditioning in Bali from {{date+60}} to {{date+63}}.

final_answer:
I searched Booking.com for **Bali, Indonesia, January 6 – January 9, 2027** (3 nights, 2 adults, 1 room, USD) with **Free WiFi**, **Air conditioning**, and property type **Hotels** all applied. The page confirms the active filter set as "Free Wifi | Hotels | Air conditioning" and returns **1,716 hotels** (note the page's own warning: "Based on your filters, 93% of places to stay are unavailable on our site" for these dates).

Hotels matching all three criteria, from the top of the results:

- **Hard Rock Hotel Bali** — Downtown Kuta, Kuta. Scored 8.6 "Excellent" (1,763 reviews), Free WiFi rated 9.0, sustainability certification. Deluxe King (max. 2 adults + 2 children under 15), 2 beds (1 king, 1 sofa bed), breakfast included, free cancellation.
- **Novotel Bali Ngurah Rai Airport** — Tuban, Kuta. Scored 8.7 "Excellent" (3,941 reviews), location 9.6, sustainability certification. Superior King Room, 1 king bed — **US$260 for 3 nights + US$55 taxes and fees**.
- **AA Inn Kuta Beach** — Kartika Plaza, near Ngurah Rai International Airport. Scored 8.7 "Excellent" (722 reviews), value for money 9.3. Double Room with Balcony, 1 king bed, taxes and fees included.
- **Hotel Arda Bali** — Negara. Scored 9.0 "Wonderful" (47 reviews), value for money 9.4. Double Room, 1 full bed, free cancellation.
- **Dune Seseh** — Munggu. Scored 9.2 "Wonderful" (344 reviews), value for money 9.1. King Suite with Balcony, private suite, 1 queen bed (3 left at that price).
- **Svadarma Bali Villa by Dhananjaya Hospitality** — Darmasaba. Scored 9.5 "Exceptional" (53 reviews), value for money 9.6. Double Room with Garden View, 1 full bed, free cancellation (6 left at that price).
- **Collection O Bali near Terminal Ubung formerly Batukaru Garden Hotel** — Cokroaminto, Kesiman. Scored 7.3 "Good" (65 reviews). Deluxe Twin Room with Direct Parking Area, 2 twin beds, free cancellation, limited-time deal.
- **GreatiStay Living&Working Canggu** — Babakan, Tumbak Bayuh. Scored 8.1 "Very Good" (48 reviews), Free WiFi rated 10. Double Room with Pool View, 1 queen bed, free cancellation.
- **Alpha Wolf Lodge** — Cemagi. Scored 9.8 "Exceptional" (19 reviews), value for money 9.9. Studio with Garden View, 240 m², 1 full bed, breakfast included, free cancellation.

All rates shown are for 3 nights, 2 adults, with taxes and fees included where noted. If you'd like, I can narrow by nightly budget (the hotel-filtered page offers US$0–US$200+), review score, or a specific area such as Kuta, Ubud, or Seminyak.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Bali dates Jan 6–9, 2027 with active filters “Free Wifi,” “Hotels,” and “Air conditioning,” listing matching hotel results.
